description_en: Creates a backup plan for a managed instance
description_zh: 为纳管实例创建备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun cddc create-prins-backup-plan --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name pr-22a21ac289e00000 --instance-class micro --period Month --used-time 1 --ecs-instance-id i-bp1726beecvi8kak0000 --backup-period Monday --backup-start-time 14:22 --backup-plan-name test0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrinsBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The Region ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the self-managed instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the backup plan. Valid values:

*   **micro**
*   **small**
*   **medium**
*   **large**
*   **xlarge**
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the purchase duration.

Valid values:

*   Month
*   Year
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

*   If **Period** is set to **Year**, the values of **UsedTime** can be from 1 to 9.
*   If **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values of **UsedTime** can be from 1 to 11
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值如下：
- 当参数**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为1~5。
- 当参数**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为1~11
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance to be backed up
parameters.help_zh: 指定备份的 ECS 实例 ID
parameters.name: ecs_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The full backup cycle. Valid values:

*   Monday
*   Tuesday
*   Wednesday
*   Thursday
*   Friday
*   Saturday
*   Sunday

> 

*   You can select multiple values and separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：

- Monday：周一
- Tuesday：周二
- Wednesday：周三
- Thursday：周四
- Friday：周五
- Saturday：周六
- Sunday：周日

> 
> - 支持选择多个取值，用英文逗号（,）分开
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The backup start time in HH:mm format
parameters.name: backup_start_time

parameters.help_en: The custom name for the backup plan
parameters.name: backup_plan_name
